5. Gallery: weather × time of day × lap position

84 frames, TLX renderer on SwiftShader (no real GPU), 1280×720 orbit (az 20, el 18, dist 45 default) / eye / trackside. Embedded at 720 px. Full frames: artifacts/shots/tracks/cota/. Naming cota-<nn>-<view>-f<frac%>-<tod>-<weather>.png.

orbit · day · dry

Baseline. Flat saturated-blue sky with no haze gradient; hard flat horizon plane; ridge backdrops read as pyramids (f33, f67); umbrella-slab acacias dominate foreground (f17).

orbit · day · wet

Road darkens correctly; grass/soil also take a mirror-like sheen.

orbit · day · rain

Sky greys, rain streaks present; dark smeared vertical reflections under stands/trees on non-road ground.

orbit · day · overcast

Flat grey light; acceptable.

orbit · day · fog

Fog = translucent ground sheets; sky stays saturated blue and distant props do not fade to horizon colour; AI cars visible at f17 (grid).

orbit · day · storm

Day storm now reads dark/grey (PR #1979 merged); still mirror smears on soil/grass; no standing water on road.

orbit · dusk · dry

Warm low light OK; sun-lit ground pools.

orbit · dusk · rain

Sky grey-amber; ground reflections glow orange; plausible.

orbit · night · dry

Pure black sky (no stars/moon). Circuit is night:false (def :25, lamp 'none' :61): no mast floodlights; ground lit by warm broad pools and trees stay bright green.

orbit · night · rain

As night/dry plus rain; foliage still day-bright.

eye · day · dry

Eye (driver) view: chequer pad at start reads pixelated; red tower (observation) visible at f67 over the T12 exit; kerbs OK.

trackside · day · dry

f00 camera sits against the main-stand wall (frame is a wall); f50 shows the DRS gantry mast; sparse infield.

eye · night · dry

Eye at night: pit-straight lamps lit (only 0.94-0.06 posts); the rest unlit but ground glows.

eye · day · rain

Rain eye view; surface reads wet; smears absent at eye level.

6. Ranked defects & suggested fixes (not applied)

#1 Mirror-like reflection smears on grass/soil/under stands in wet, rain, storm and dusk-rain
Seen: orbit f17/f33/f67 wet|rain|storm; storm f17 left half
Wet-surface response is applied to non-road terrain and props (vertical dark ghost copies under grandstand/tree). Not circuit-specific; mechanism NOT diagnosed here — look at the wet/reflection path in js/lighting/ and js/render/three/ (PR #1979 touched js/lighting/atmosphere.js). Fix: gate reflection to road/kerb materials or fade on MAT.GRASS/soil.
#2 Flat sky and hard horizon: no Hill-Country haze; fog weather does not fade distance
Seen: orbit/eye day dry f00-f83; fog f33 f67
Brief §2 asks for warm haze fading boxes to dusty green-grey. def pal.horizon [0.74,0.68,0.52] (js/circuits/cota.js:40) is defined, but the rendered horizon is a saturated blue to a hard green plane edge. Fog adds ground sheets only. Probably engine fog/sky (js/lighting/atmosphere.js), not scenery. Fix: raise horizon haze / fog density at distance for day theme green.
#3 Oversized umbrella-slab trees dominate frames
Seen: orbit f17 left, f33 right, f83; eye f17/f33
acacia(...) mesquite scatter scenery/cota.js:473-490: th 5.5-8.5 m, spread th*(1.15..1.55) ⇒ ~13 m flat stacked canopies; 16 instances (i<16, s 0.275-0.4175), plus plane() live oaks :492-498 (7 at 0.752-0.8). Fix: spread ×0.6, add trunk taper or fewer; keep left-side mesquite ≤ row 1 (comment :477-485).
#4 Ridgeline backdrops mostly culled; survivors are bare pyramids
Seen: orbit f33 right horizon, f67 centre horizon
verify-track: guard drops backdrop=11 (of 15 hillAnchors, scenery/cota.js:397-418); only ~4 survive and read as isolated cones. Which 11 were dropped was NOT identified (diagnostics print counts only). Fix: print per-anchor drop reason; shrink d (depth) or move dist so footprints clear on-track guard (COTA folds on itself, see :477-485).
#5 Motorhome / pit block buried up to 5.41 m in terrain
Seen: orbit f00 (left side), eye f00
ground-audit --why: buried worst 5.41 m at scenery/cota.js:154 (motorhome(K(0.99), -1, 40,…)) ×4 prims; also :336 (0.12 m ×4), :160 (0.09), :228 (0.19), city.js:491 (0.08). terrainOuter 60 (circuits/cota.js:35) comment says the SRTM straight sits up to 10 m over the lap low point. Fix: pull :154 inward (gap ≤ 25) or seat on a groundPatch pad.
#6 Night: no floodlights, black sky, foliage day-bright
Seen: orbit/eye night dry/rain
COTA is night:false (circuits/cota.js:25) and furniture.lamp 'none' (:61), so no authored night lighting (survey-track SKILL: night authored only for 7 circuits). Lamp posts at scenery/cota.js:583-594 (0.94-0.06) have lamp heads but no visible emission. Real COTA runs a night race. Fix: low priority; if wanted, set night support + masts per lighting-tuner.
#7 Orbit/trackside cameras at s=0 sit inside the main-stand footprint
Seen: orbit f00 all weathers; trackside f00
grandstandEx(0.00,1,8,150,…) at scenery/cota.js:81 with cantilever roof (roofY 20.6, :84-92) gives a dark steel wall filling the left of every f00 orbit and a pure wall in trackside f00. Camera-side issue (use --through off / other az); not a prop defect. Note only.
#8 Coplanar fight: acacia canopy × billboard, and stand roof self-overlap
Seen: fights from ~119 m
coplanar-audit: 1 pair, gap 2.8 mm, 3.3 m² (baseline 1). ground-audit flatCoplanar: scenery/cota.js:89 roof slats self (9.28 m²), nature.js:802 acacia self (40.68 m²) and acacia × cota.js:551 billboard (3.68 m²). Within baseline. Fix: offset billboard :551 or acacia layer by ≥ 2 cm.
#9 Elevation under-built vs real Turn 1 climb (uncertain)
Seen: —
Built start y 0.09 m → T1 crest 11.77 m (s 0.075): 11.7 m climb, 22.6 m total range. Public sources quote 133 ft (≈40.5 m) for the start-to-T1 climb (PlanetF1) but other pages quote it as lap elevation change — sources disagree, so UNCERTAIN. docs/tracks/cota.md already flags this as a deliberate physics decision (elevations drive handling). Not a scenery fix.
#10 Tooling: build-gallery cannot tag 'storm' shots
Seen: gallery filters
tools/track/build-gallery.cjs:42 WEATHER_TAIL lists dry|wet|rain|fog|overcast only; a <tod>-storm tail falls to tod 'unknown'. See gallery-build result. Fix: add storm to WEATHER_TAIL / splitTodWeather. Gallery build confirmed: all 84 cota frames listed (78 tagged correctly, 6 storm = unknown). Also: build-gallery help says `--out DIR` but only `--out=DIR` parses (:644-645); the space form silently wrote into the tracked gallery/tracks/ (restored with git checkout).

7. Code & scenery deep-dive

  • Frame of reference: no sceneryStartFrac (def :17-21): every scenery frac is the racing lap fraction from the start line; the old 0.416 shift was removed and elevation/bank keys re-keyed (+0.41596).
  • Sequence in scenery file: stands (:81-150) → pit buildings (:153-162) → Big Red (:174-207) → Esses mounds (:209-213) → bleachers/terrace/hill (:215-228) → amphitheatre + tower (:230-298) → plaza pad + pool (:300-303) → mounds (:305-334) → red frameworks (:346-360) → camping (:362-393) → backdrops (:397-418) → skyline/forest (:433-471) → mesquite/oaks (:473-498) → gantries (:503-526) → runoff patches (:528-532) → fences/rails/tyres/billboards/marshals (:534-569) → paddock car park (:571-581) → pit lamps (:583-594).
  • Guards: hero groups use onTrack checks (:97, :189, :572) so a fold-back lap drops them silently; mesquite note :477-485 documents the left-side limit (~50 m before landing on the other leg).
  • Assets: materials only via MAT.CONCRETE/METAL/GLASS on hero groups; props are procedural primitives (boxes, prisms, frusta, cones). Baked PBR pack applies via MAT ids; no external model files referenced.
  • Real-world cross-check: 20 turns, 5.513 km, 251 ft tower, T1 uphill left — consistent (sources linked in §1; PlanetF1 guide). 133 ft figure ambiguous (§6 #9). Track width, DRS straight length and amphitheatre geometry are estimates, not verified here.
